release_notes: **Option Scanner runs as a background job**: scans run in a server-side thread, so leaving the page no longer kills them and the last result is restored on return. Flow auto-refresh now runs server-side, the whole form is persisted, and a Stop button (page and top-bar badge) cancels a scan and ends auto-refresh. The top-bar badge shows running / ready / auto-refresh / recording state on every page. **Reports page keeps its place across navigation**: tab, filters, sim session, intraday date and scroll position are restored when you return (per browser tab). **Option Scanner form restore** no longer crashes in Specific/Top modes.
